entities.summary: Andrew Norwell is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes and was signed as an undrafted free agent by the Carolina Panthers in 2014. Norwell has also played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and the Washington Commanders.
